items.title: YAMAGoya – Real-Time Threat Monitoring Tool Using Sigma and YARA Rules
items.description: Modern cybersecurity faces an escalating challenge: fileless malware and obfuscation techniques increasingly bypass traditional file-based detection methods. To address this growing threat, JPCERT/CC has released YAMAGoya. This open-source threat hunting tool leverages industry-standard detection rules to identify suspicious activity in real time. items.title: Apache Syncope Vulnerability Allows Attacker to Access Internal Database Content

The flaw stems from a hardcoded default encryption key used for password storage, allowing attackers with database access to recover plaintext passwords.
